notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR3: data-name-2, -3 and -4, "when not being used must contain spaces". CommunicationArea#QueuePath reads the four 12-character levels with trailing spaces trimmed, and MessageDefinitions#FindQueue takes an all-space level as unused (every level below it must then be spaces too) and any other content as a name, so ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT, ENABLE/DISABLE INPUT and RECEIVE (MessageControlSession) answer the structure the non-space levels name. Probes at --std 85: spaces count the whole queue (3) and a named sub-queue its own (1); a level named below a space level, LOW-VALUES and a lowercase name are status 20; the witness shows a name in an unused level asks for that sub-queue.
